test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

This passage has been cleaned by Bhanu with his vacuum cleaner.

options.text: Bhanu has cleaned this passage with his vacuum cleaner.
Bhanu has cleaned his vacuum cleaner with this passage.
Bhanu was cleaning this passage with his vacuum cleaner.
Bhanu had cleaned this passage with his vacuum cleaner.

solution:
The active voice of the given sentence is __**Bhanu has cleaned this passage with his vacuum cleaner.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__present perfect tense__ 

The present perfect tense refers to an action or state that either occurred at an indefinite time in the past or began in the past and continued to the present time.

 
 
 
 

 Passive
 
 Active
 
 
 

 object+ has/have+ been + V3 + by + subject
 
 Subject +has/have + V3 + object.
 
 
 

__
 
• 
 The instructions given below should be followed while changing a passive voice to an active voice.

 
 
• 
 Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
 
• 
 Remove the preposition 'by' before the agent.
 
 
• 
 Change has + been of the passive voice into 'have' according to the subject to make it an active voice.
 
 
• 
 At last line up the remaining part.
 
 
 

So, the final sentence is - Bhanu has cleaned this passage with his vacuum cleaner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__Impersonal Passive__

 
• Verbs without an object (intransitive verb) normally cannot form a personal passive sentence (as there is no object that can become the subject of the passive sentence). If you want to use an intransitive verb in passive voice, you need an impersonal construction – therefore this passive voice is called Impersonal Passive.

 
 
• Example: he says – it is said
